body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics showcased its stylish LCD HDTV Series 'LU55' at LG press conference during 2009 CES.

The LG LU55 series offers stylish accents for the home office, kitchen, or bedroom with small screen sizes and transparent and modern designs. It features 26- and 22-inch sizes are Full HD 1080p, 19-inch has 720p HD Resolution and transparent design.
